Solution 2 is correct. Completing the square gives $x^2+2.6x+3.6=(x+1.3)^2+(3.6-1.69)=(x+1.3)^2+1.91$, so $b=1.3$, $c=1.91$, and $b+c=3.21$.

Solution 1 miscalculates $c$ as $3.6-1.3^2=0.31$. The correct value is $1.91$.

Solution 3 also miscalculates $c$, writing $3.6-1.69$ as $2.31$ instead of $1.91$.

CHOICE: 2
